posts.title: Juniper Green Note Secures National Lottery Funding Through Creative Scotland
posts.description: Juniper Green Note, Edinburgh’s grassroots jazz club based at Baberton Golf Club, has received funding from The National Lottery through Creative Scotland — a significant step forward for the club since its founding in October 2025. posts.title: Juniper Green Note Celebrates Sold-Out Jazz Night
posts.description: A thriving local grassroots jazz club is continuing to strike a chord with audiences across Balerno and Juniper Green. The Juniper Green Note, based at Baberton Golf Club, recently celebrated another sell-out evening, this time featuring acclaimed Scottish violinist and vocalist Seonaid Aitken.
